skill.name: pre-client
skill.description: Analyzes inbound email conversations to identify sender context, buying signals, relationship timelines, and high-potential sales opportunities.

security_audit.summary: The static command-execution alerts are false positives caused by Markdown code fences in SKILL.md. The role-token alerts are labels inside example workflow blocks, not attempts to override model instructions. The skill still describes privacy-sensitive email analysis and prospect enrichment, so it needs clear consent, scope, and retention controls.

remediation.issue: Privacy-sensitive email and prospect data processing
remediation.suggestion: Document required consent, mailbox scope, retention limits, and access controls before using inbox, CRM, or enrichment data.

remediation.issue: External enrichment services may receive personal or company data
remediation.suggestion: Require user-approved integrations and least-privilege API scopes for LinkedIn, Crunchbase, search, CRM, and email providers.
Rename labels such as PRE-CLIENT SYSTEM to neutral terms like Example workflow to reduce audit noise.

content.value_statement: Inbound email can hide valuable prospects, buying signals, and urgent follow-up needs. This skill analyzes messages, profiles senders, scores opportunities, and recommends next sales actions.
actual_capabilities: Extracts sender identity, company, role, location, and available contact details from inbound emails.
Classifies buying signals by intent level, urgency, timeline, and stated business problem.
Groups related messages into conversation threads using sender, company, topic, and timing.
Builds relationship timelines that show prospect activity, participants, and next-stage predictions.
Scores opportunities with fit, intent, engagement, and timeline factors.
Suggests sales follow-up actions based on opportunity tier and prospect context.
limitations: Version 1 does not include real-time email API integration.
Version 1 does not include automated CRM synchronization.
Scoring is rule-based and does not include machine learning models.
The skill does not generate automated reply sequences or email templates.

use_cases.title: Qualify New Inbound Leads
use_cases.description: Review a new prospect email and identify intent, business problem, timeline, and recommended response priority.

use_cases.title: Rank Weekly Opportunities
use_cases.description: Compare recent inbound conversations and decide which prospects need same-day or next-day follow-up.

use_cases.title: Prepare CRM Context
use_cases.description: Summarize sender profile, thread history, buying committee signals, and next actions before a CRM update.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze One Email
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this inbound email. Identify the sender, company, problem, buying signal, intent tier, and best next action.

prompt_templates.title: Cluster a Conversation
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these related emails. Group them into one conversation, summarize the timeline, and identify changes in urgency or intent.

prompt_templates.title: Score an Opportunity
prompt_templates.prompt: Score this prospect using fit, intent, engagement, and timeline. Explain each score and recommend a follow-up plan.

prompt_templates.title: Prioritize a Pipeline
prompt_templates.prompt: Rank these inbound prospects by sales priority. Highlight top opportunities, expected value, risks, and actions for the next week.

output_examples.input: A prospect asks about pricing, mentions a Q1 migration, and includes a manager and CTO in the thread.
output_examples.output: The skill marks the lead as high intent, identifies an active buying committee, estimates a strong timeline fit, and recommends a discovery call.

output_examples.input: A weekly inbox review includes twelve new prospect conversations with mixed urgency and unclear business problems.
output_examples.output: The skill ranks the conversations into priority tiers and lists the few prospects that need immediate human follow-up.

output_examples.input: A sales team needs context before adding a prospect to the CRM.
output_examples.output: The skill summarizes sender details, company context, conversation history, buying signals, and recommended next steps.

best_practices: Use only email and enrichment data that your organization is allowed to process.
Review opportunity scores with human judgment before assigning sales priority.
Keep prospect summaries concise and focused on business relevance.
anti_patterns: Do not use the skill to profile people outside approved sales workflows.
Do not treat inferred budget, role, or authority as verified facts.
Do not connect mailbox, CRM, or enrichment services without user approval.

faq.question: What does this skill analyze?
faq.answer: It analyzes inbound emails, sender context, thread history, buying signals, and opportunity priority.

faq.question: Does it send emails automatically?
faq.answer: No. The documented scope recommends next actions but does not automate replies or campaigns.

faq.question: Can it connect to a CRM?
faq.answer: The skill describes CRM sync as an integration point, but Version 1 does not automate CRM synchronization.

faq.question: How does it score opportunities?
faq.answer: It uses fit, intent, engagement, and timeline signals to create a priority score.

faq.question: Who should use this skill?
faq.answer: Sales teams, founders, and revenue operations teams can use it to triage inbound prospects.

faq.question: What privacy controls are needed?
faq.answer: Use approved data sources, limit mailbox access, define retention, and review prospect data before sharing.
